headline.text: L1 Sollich 3 re-cleaned for metal; labeler belt replaced. L3 time clock is offline. Most other issues cleared in *under an hour*.

per_plant_summary.L1: Sollich 3 found metal and nuts in the enrober during startup and re-cleaned, delaying the line roughly 45 minutes. An All-Fill labeler belt failed and was replaced by midday. Sollich 1 ran the Hershey marshmallow trial; cookies clogged the Sweco and inclusion depositor but the team removed the magnet per customer approval and continued. A metal detector test was skipped due to maintenance unavailability.
per_plant_summary.L2: Molding Line 2 stopped twice—first for a bad B1 sensor, then for a broken chain spring—but both repairs finished within the hour. FFS took 90 minutes to adjust the printer during the case-5 changeover. Otherwise smooth.
per_plant_summary.L3: Molding Line 4 cleared a lot-code printer issue and a depositor drain clog, both in under 10 minutes. Truffle line had a mower-belt jam that cleared in 30 minutes and a dosing-pump fault that reset immediately. The time clock lost internet and is still offline. The Matrix pallet-wrapper roller was bent removing stuck plastic.

notes.text: Sollich 1 ran the first Hershey trial; team worked around cookie-clogging by removing the magnet with customer sign-off.
Truffle tunnel temps are being held out of centerline intentionally to prevent soft product; production and quality aligned.

resolved.title: S3 metal and nuts found in enrober at startup
resolved.summary: Metal powder and nut pieces appeared in the enrober wire mesh during initial run; production requested a second Level 4 clean.
resolved.resolution: Re-clean completed and cleared at 10:35 — visual and QA sign-off (Charity Young).

resolved.title: S3 reserve-tank caramel dark and bitter
resolved.summary: Caramel held in the reserve tank since 20:10 the previous evening was off-spec; QA tested and advised disposal.
resolved.resolution: Decision at 23:39 — "should be thrown out" (Chris Whitaker).

resolved.title: S3 All-Fill labeler top-trap belt damaged
resolved.summary: Belt damage caused pouch wrinkles; All-Fill tech replaced the belt and adjusted speeds to eliminate wrinkles.
resolved.resolution: Belt replaced and tested by 12:10 — "last 30-40 jars had no wrinkles at all" (Troy Baxter).

resolved.title: S1 cookies clogging Sweco and magnet
resolved.summary: Graham cookies stuck in Sweco screen and magnet; Hershey approved magnet removal to continue the trial run.
resolved.resolution: Magnet removed at 10:01 — approved by Hershey QA, trial continued (Justin Garner).

resolved.title: ML2 B1 sensor failed
resolved.summary: Bad B1 sensor stopped the line; maintenance replaced it and performed a CIL during the stoppage.

resolved.title: ML2 broken spring on chain
resolved.summary: Chain spring broke shortly after the sensor repair; Justin located a replacement and tightened loose springs on adjacent links.
resolved.resolution: Replaced at 10:49 — "tightened a few others that were loose" (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: FFS printer misaligned during case-5 changeover
resolved.summary: Printer would not adjust laterally and was only printing on half the box; maintenance worked through alignment and settings.

resolved.title: ML2 vacuum infeed twin belts not tracking
resolved.summary: Belts were misaligned; maintenance performed a hard reset to restore tracking.

resolved.title: Truffle mower belt problem
resolved.summary: Belt issue on the mower caused a line stop; operators and maintenance addressed the jam.
resolved.resolution: Running at 22:56 — "The line is running smoothly" (TruffleLine Enrober).

resolved.title: ML4 depositor #2 water drain clogged
resolved.summary: Drain hose blocked, water filling; operators paused to unclog and restarted within 5 minutes.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 06:53 — "working correctly," 3-minute solution time (ML4 TG).

resolved.title: ML1 tempering machine breaker tripped
resolved.summary: Alarm active on tempering unit; maintenance called and reset the breaker, returned machine to melting mode.
resolved.resolution: Reset at 07:50 — "now back in melting mode" (Nathan Ruiz).

resolved.title: ML4 lot-code printer not showing number
resolved.summary: Printer roll was not pushed all the way back; maintenance diagnosed it as a training issue and corrected the installation.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance fixed at 00:38 — roll repositioned, "Training" noted (ML4 WDS).

resolved.title: Truffle dosing pump faulted out
resolved.summary: Flavor dosing pump threw a fault during production; quick reset restored operation.

resolved.title: Scissor lift blocking electrical panel
resolved.summary: Lift was parked in front of a panel, obstructing airflow; operator moved it immediately when flagged.

resolved.title: Chain broken link on pallet conveyor
resolved.summary: Maintenance identified and repaired a broken chain link when asked to inspect.

needs_attention.title: S2 metal detector final test missed at 06:30
needs_attention.summary: Unable to perform the scheduled final metal detector test due to mechanical issues on Sollich 3 and maintenance unavailability.
needs_attention.status: Test skipped at 06:30; no reschedule time posted (Chris Featherstone).

needs_attention.title: S1 Level 4 clean areas not signed off
needs_attention.summary: QA found that certain areas listed in the Level 4 clean book were not documented or signed off as completed.
needs_attention.status: Flagged at 11:33; no closure or sign-off confirmation posted.

needs_attention.title: S3 blue plastic shavings on belt C19
needs_attention.summary: QA spotted blue plastic shavings during the post-clean inspection; Z conveyor ran for 2 minutes with no recurrence, but monitoring was requested.
needs_attention.status: Observed at 11:47; Z conveyor tested clean, monitoring ongoing (Constanza Araya).

needs_attention.title: S1 pretzels found on bed during Hershey trial
needs_attention.summary: Operator found pretzels on the molding bed; no explanation or corrective action posted.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 12:01; no follow-up action posted in the chat.

needs_attention.title: Time clock not connected to internet
needs_attention.summary: The plant time clock lost its network connection; employees cannot clock in or out digitally.
needs_attention.status: Offline as of 23:11; no IT or maintenance response posted.

needs_attention.title: MF Matrix pallet wrapper roller bent
needs_attention.summary: Plastic got stuck between the rollers; when operators removed it, one roller was bent and needs repair or replacement.
needs_attention.status: Roller bent at 06:17; no maintenance resolution posted.

needs_attention.title: ML1 toffee allergen test pending for ZS Heath trial
needs_attention.summary: Trial requires allergen test results on toffee bits before pouching can resume; test requested, results awaited as of 13:24.
needs_attention.status: Allergen test requested at 12:58, waiting for QA results as of 13:24 (Jenny Medina).

needs_attention.title: Truffle tunnel temps held out of centerline
needs_attention.summary: Operators are intentionally running tunnel temperatures outside the centerline range to avoid soft product; production and quality are aligned on the variance.
needs_attention.status: Variance explained at 07:31; Shawn approved the adjusted range for this flavor (Grey Boscan, Shawn Jewkes).
